tasks.title: Environment + project template
tasks.brief: Install/verify Premiere, ffmpeg, python3. Build the standard .prproj template: bins (footage/audio/graphics/sequences/exports), colour labels, 1080p24 and 1080p30 sequence presets, autosave + scratch config.

tasks.title: Keyboard-only assembly drill
tasks.brief: Learn J/K/L, in/out, insert vs overwrite, ripple/roll/slip/slide. Assemble a 60s sequence from 20 supplied clips without touching the mouse, three times, timed.
acceptance: can name what ripple vs roll does without looking

tasks.title: First teardown: Company Man
tasks.brief: Full teardown of one Company Man video using the CSV schema in skills/teardown-coach.md. Every cut logged.
acceptance: CSV has one row per cut (expect 120+)
median shot length and cuts/min computed

tasks.title: Rhythm triptych
tasks.brief: Cut the same 60s material three ways: avg 1.8s shots, 3.5s, 6s. Read Murch ch.1-3 first.
acceptance: can state Murch's Rule of Six from memory

tasks.title: Loudness literacy
tasks.brief: LUFS vs peak vs RMS. Measure 10 reference videos' loudness with tools/loudness_check.py. Record findings.
acceptance: can explain why -16 LUFS is the narration target

tasks.title: Narration chain preset
tasks.brief: Build the house narration chain as a saved Premiere preset: denoise, de-ess, HPF 80Hz, +2dB @3.5kHz, comp 3:1, limiter. Apply to 3 voice samples.
acceptance: each stage's purpose explained in one line

tasks.title: Ducking + bed placement
tasks.brief: Sidechain ducking: bed at -24 LUFS, 6-8dB duck under narration. Fix a badly mixed 2-minute segment from the target episode.

tasks.title: First SFX batch
tasks.brief: Source/edit 20 SFX (impacts, whooshes, UI ticks, paper). Trim, normalise -18 LUFS, name per convention, write licence sidecars.

tasks.title: Room tone library
tasks.brief: Build 5 x 60s loopable room-tone/air beds. Study why premium edits never contain digital silence.
acceptance: seamless loop verified by ear at the join
one paragraph: where each bed suits

tasks.title: P1 ship: full audio re-master
tasks.brief: The capstone: re-master the full target episode's audio using everything above. This ships.
acceptance: dev A/B signoff recorded in dev/changelog.md

tasks.title: Shot matching drill
tasks.brief: Match 10 clips from 10 different sources to one reference frame using Lumetri. This is the archive-footage problem in miniature.
acceptance: dev picks the 2 weakest matches; he re-does them

tasks.title: First LUT, verified through ffmpeg
tasks.brief: Build one 33-point .cube LUT and verify it through ffmpeg lut3d, not just Premiere preview.
